description: Language-neutral law of the read-only brush suggestions tool run (ticket 26/09/13/INTERACTIVE-TOOLS-VISIBLE-PROCESS lane W2-C). A scene holds one host object `host` with vortex `v0` (kind port-a) and two catalogue kinds `Near` and `Late` whose port-b vortex docks onto it; every catalogue mesh is an 8-unit cube, the host's own mesh is unregistered and collides as the scaled box fallback. `blocker` parks a second object of the host's kind, carrying its OWN cube mesh, exactly where both candidates dock. Each case pins the final verdict of every candidate in candidate order (`verdict:reason`), the free kinds, the three counters (tested, free, collisions) and the steps (`kind:reason[:args]`).
